Import GRN from gene x TF matrix (CSV format)

Source: R/import-grn.R
import_grn_pipeline.Rd

Import a GRN from a gene x TF matrix stored as CSV. This is the format produced by the context_specific_grn. The matrix has genes as rows and TFs as columns, with regulatory weights as values.

import_grn_pipeline(path, normalize = TRUE, min_weight = 0, verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

path

Path to the gene_x_tf.csv file

normalize

Logical, whether to normalize weights per TF (default: TRUE)

min_weight

Minimum weight threshold to include edge (default: 0)

verbose

Logical, print progress messages (default: TRUE)

Value

A ContextGRN object

Details

The normalization step scales weights so that the maximum value for each TF (column) is 1. This ensures comparable regulatory strengths across TFs.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
grn <- import_grn_pipeline("path/to/gene_x_tf.csv")
} # }
